positive_controls: all three condition scores recover into one exact run identity
explicit recovery does not add invocation calls
recovered outcome is projected with task-family identity and no oracle parameters
later cognition admits the observed result using the normal writeback path

implementation.claim_boundary: All inference receipts and answers are fixture-produced. This test validates crash recovery/custody composition only; no production, physical, or actual-model improvement is established.
implementation.later_cognition: The recovered family score projects to a historical World-State fact, is consumed through ordinary resident writeback, and exact family lineage is retained.
implementation.recovery_path: Inject an interruption after three independently scored condition checkpoints but before aggregate run publication. A reconstructed owner performs existing checkpoint recovery; the read-only projection remains empty before explicit recovery and exposes the recovered run afterward.

objective: Prove that a completed task-family score is not lost if aggregate publication is interrupted, and that recovered evidence reaches normal World-State and admitted history without inference replay.
